description: This file defines the 'Comments.List' feature, including a Query request and its handler for retrieving comments associated with an article identified by its slug. It interacts with the database context to fetch article comments, includes related author data, and handles cases where the article isn't found.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents a request for retrieving comments for an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the 'List.Query' request by querying the database for the article and its comments, and returning the comments envelope or throwing an exception if the article is not found.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the query to fetch comments linked to an article with the given slug.
